scope: Evidence sphere, retained executable capabilities, and registered performance workloads

invariants.evidence_nodes_and_edges: Existing identity and payload remain; append corrections, contradictions and successors
invariants.capabilities: Retain each baseline ID and acceptance-contract hash, with new exact-subject PASS evidence
invariants.performance: No registered metric may worsen, and no improvement may compensate another metric or tail regression
invariants.comparison: Same workload, environment, protocol, units, direction and sample count; integer observations with at least five samples
invariants.baseline_selection: Independently attested accepted predecessor; never choose a worse historical baseline
invariants.unknown_or_incomparable: HOLD; not PASS and not an improvement

promotion_integration.required: Every writer activating a successor must consume a fresh eligible receipt bound to externally attested baseline and candidate observations, recheck current accepted predecessor before compare-and-swap, and obtain ordinary authority/review admission
